about: Starter strength routine library (6.102.0). One row per routine (kind lift_lib), shown in the Lifts tab's Routine picker. The routine a person is on lives only in coach/strength.json (lift_routine); its id matches a row here, and that row is the one preselected and marked Recommended. A pick saved on the dashboard (store doc lift_pref/routine) is a request: the coach runs the routine change checks and the person's preferences, then moves them over at the next morning check-in. All five cover squat, hinge, push, pull and core twice a week; they differ in equipment and minutes.

rows.name: Long Life Lifts
rows.needs: Dumbbells, a pull-up bar, a band
rows.lifts: Pistol squat warm-up; 2 s pause front squat; weighted pull-up; DB Romanian deadlift; incline DB bench; band face pulls; single-leg calf raise; side plank

rows.name: Home, no equipment
rows.best_for: Starting out, or no weights at home
rows.lifts: Split squat; single-leg glute bridge; push-up, incline to decline; table row; side plank; calf raise

rows.name: Bands, for travel
rows.lifts: Band squat; band Romanian deadlift; band press; band row; Pallof press; single-leg calf raise

rows.name: Kettlebell
rows.best_for: One piece of kit, whole body
rows.lifts: Goblet squat; kettlebell deadlift, then swing; floor press; one-arm row; suitcase carry; step-up

rows.name: Gym, barbell
rows.lifts: Back squat; deadlift; bench press; pull-up or row; Romanian deadlift; plank
